trust_decision.summary: A regular expression supplied by a JSON-mapper author (formula text) is compiled and executed against untrusted feed/upload data on the main Node event loop with a backtracking engine; the fix decides to run that pattern only with a linear-time engine (RE2) inside the extractWithRegexp helper of the mapper formula context.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'ReDoS in JSON Ingestion Mapper'; the only `new RegExp(` with a caller-supplied pattern in src/parser is the extractWithRegexp helper exposed to mapper formulas.

fix_sites.entry_point: GraphQL mutations jsonMapperTest / ingestionJsonTester (CSVMAPPERS) and the scheduled JSON feed ingestion (ingestion-json-domain.ts:150,165) via jsonMappingExecution -> extractComplexPathFromJson

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only json-mapper.ts:93 (plus dependency files). It reaches all callers through the one shared helper, both attribute complex_path (json-mapper.ts:221) and mapper-level variables (json-mapper.ts:398). No published site sits in an out-of-scope module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and fix name only extractWithRegexp. A solver can argue that the formula sandbox's own `RegExp` global and regex literals (safeEjs.ts:58) belong to a generic sandbox shared with notification templates, and that safeRender already has maxExecutionDuration (json-mapper.ts:113). It can likewise argue that JSONPath filter expressions belong to the third-party jsonpath-plus library, which is not mapper code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Mapper JSONPath target filters legitimately use JS regex with lookahead (MISP mapper: `@.value.match(/...(\.(?!$)|$).../)`). extractWithRegexp must still return the capture group and fall back to the original value on no match. If a fix swaps every regex to RE2 or forbids regex in paths or formulas, the lookahead filter stops working (RE2 has no lookaround), and so do notification templates that use RegExp through the same sandbox.

O6_input_shapes: pattern passed as the extractWithRegexp first argument from an attribute complex_path formula
same helper reached from a mapper-level variable formula (json-mapper.ts:398)
groupIndex out of range -> now returns original value (fix.diff:107)

O7_producer.where: Mapper representations are stored as a JSON string and later re-parsed. Writers are jsonMapperImport (modules/internal/jsonMapper/jsonMapper-domain.ts:63-69), jsonMapperAdd and jsonMapperFieldPatch. Reload happens at ingestion via JSON.parse (modules/ingestion/ingestion-json-domain.ts:142-147). Neither path validates the regex or formula; the regex is only compiled at execution time.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A mapper formula can build a backtracking regex directly, because the safeEjs sandbox whitelists the RegExp global and regex literals and string .match/.replace/.split are not filtered. That regex runs in-thread on feed data, and the statement/duration guard cannot interrupt a single exec call.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The sandbox is generic (shared with notifiers/email templates) and has a 5s maxExecutionDuration (json-mapper.ts:113), so it looks already bounded. In fact the check runs only at statement boundaries (safeEjs.ts:99-115), not inside a regex.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, utils/ vs parser/ (same package)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: json-mapper calls the in-thread safeEjs.safeRender. Every other untrusted-template caller uses the worker-isolated safeEjs.client with a hard timeout and terminate. The mapper formula route therefore lacks the isolation that bounds a runaway regex elsewhere.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Switching to the worker client changes the mapper's sync/async and data-serialization contract: functions such as extractWithRegexp and patternFromValue in `data` cannot be posted to a worker (safeEjs.client.ts:46-47). This looks like an architecture change rather than a fix.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Mapper JSONPath paths (representation target path, attribute paths, variable paths) accept filter expressions that run JS regex .match on feed values in-thread through jsonpath-plus.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The regex runs inside the third-party jsonpath-plus evaluator, and the project's own MISP mapper relies on lookahead regex there (tests/01-unit/parser/json-mapper-misp.ts:775), so RE2 cannot be used and it looks like an intended feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different function; evaluator in node_modules/jsonpath-plus

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A helper such as replaceWithRegexp or splitWithRegexp next to decisionMatrix, compiling the formula-supplied pattern with new RegExp.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The formula helper set is a small ad-hoc list (patternFromValue, extractWithRegexp, decisionMatrix). A string-cleanup helper is a natural addition for feed normalisation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A CSV-mapper equivalent of extractWithRegexp, i.e. a second implementation in the sibling mapper that json-mapper already imports helpers from (json-mapper.ts:49).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CSV and JSON mappers share formatValue/computeDefaultValue, so feature parity requests are typical.

O10_build.toolchain: yarn (berry) + vitest. The fix adds the native re2 addon (node-gyp; prebuilt binaries fetched from GitHub by install-artifact-from-github).
O10_build.project_tests: tests/01-unit/parser/json-parser-test.js and tests/01-unit/parser/json-mapper-misp.ts are unit tests (jsonMappingExecution with testContext; may need schema init but no DB for the parser path - unverified). tests/01-unit/utils/safeEjs-test.ts covers the sandbox. Ingestion tests are in tests/03-integration (need ES/Redis/RabbitMQ).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap `new RegExp` for RE2 (or add a pattern-length or nested-quantifier check) inside extractWithRegexp only, leaving the sandbox's RegExp global, regex literals and JSONPath filter regex running in-thread.
